headlines.name: Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows_code
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length) {q : ℕ}
  (e :
    Fin q ≃
      OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallContextCoordinates.Cells
        (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U))
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
  List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr z) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largePaddedMargins true
      ((((OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.cellCatalog
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) e,
              OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.viewList
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U) e
                (OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.physicalProfile
                  (OAI.ContingencyTables.CompletionCounts.firstPaperSmall r c U)
                  (Math115.ReducedSmallChain.capacity r c U L) r c L z)
                false),
            List.ofFn r, List.ofFn c),
          U),
        L)

headlines.name: Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionDraw_code
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h : ℕ)
  (word : Fin (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.bits r c U L hr hc z h) → Bool),
  Math115.LatticeSampler.draw
      (((List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseRows r c U L hr z),
            List.ofFn (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.coarseColumns r c U L hc z)),
          h),
        List.ofFn word) =
    OAI.ContingencyTables.DensePrograms.matrixCode
      ↑((Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.finiteFibreEquiv r c U L hr hc z)
          (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionDraw r c U L hr hc z h word))

headlines.name: Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionLaw_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length)
  (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L) (h : ℕ),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.completionLaw r c U L hr hc z h)
      OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.uniformLaw ≤
    Math115.CompletionRetryBudget.dyadic h

headlines.name: Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.oracleFamily_accuracy
headlines.statement:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (r : Fin m → ℕ) (c : Fin n → ℕ) (U L : ℕ)
  (hr : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn r)).length)
  (hc : 0 < (OAI.ContingencyTables.ProfilePrograms.largeIndices (U, List.ofFn c)).length) (h : ℕ)
  (i : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeRows r U)
  (j : OAI.ContingencyTables.SmallGraphProfiles.LargeColumns c U) (z : Math115.ReducedSmallChain.States r c U L),
  OAI.ContingencyTables.FirstSuccess.variation (Math115.LegacyPhysicalCompletion.oracleFamily r c U L hr hc h i j z)
